Hello Brian, I checked your records, and two things from my colleague's earlier message were wrong.

**Invoice RO-327743:** I can't see an $840 "shop supplies" charge. The invoice has labour of 2.9 hours at $165 per hour and parts of $131.05. The total is $688.79 CAD, with taxes included. I also can't promise that anything will be removed. I'm sending this to the service manager, who will review your question.

**Lease inspection:** I haven't booked anything yet. My system shows your Kestrel as owned, with no lease end date. I don't want to book the wrong thing. Please check your lease papers, or ask the branch to confirm the lease. A person will follow up with you on this too.
